103
104    public List<Map<String,String>> convert(List<Map<String,String>> src) {
105
106        List<Map<String,String>> out = new ArrayList<>();
107
108        for (Map<String,String> inRow : src) {
109
110            // Skip completely empty rows
111            if (isEffectivelyEmptyRow(inRow)) {
112                continue;
113            }
114
115            String[] raw = inRow.values().toArray(new String[inRow.size()]);
116            Map<String,String> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();
117
118            for (String newCol : HEADER) {
119
120                int oldPos = INDEX_MAP.get(newCol);
121                int idx = oldPos - 1;
122
123                String val = (idx < raw.length ? raw[idx] : "");
124                val = (val == null ? "" : val.trim());
125
126                // SPECIAL: Unique Key cleanup
127                switch (newCol) {
128                    case "Unique Key":
129                        row.put("Unique Key", stripThresholdForUniqueKey(val));
130                        continue;
131
132
133                        // SPECIAL: Recording Name cleanup
134                    case "Recording Name":
135                        row.put("Recording Name", stripThresholdFromRecordingName(val));
136                        continue;
137
138
139                        // SPECIAL: Label Number must be a valid integer
140                    case "Label Number":
141                        row.put("Label Number", parseOrZero(val));
142                        continue;
143                }
144
145                // Normal mapping
146                row.put(newCol, val);
147            }
148
149            out.add(row);
150        }
151
152        System.out.println("ROWS OUT: " + out.size());
153        for (int i = 0; i < out.size(); i++) {
154            Map<String,String> r = out.get(i);
155            boolean empty = isEffectivelyEmptyRow(r);
156            if (empty) {
157                System.out.println("⚠ EMPTY OUTPUT ROW at index " + i);
158            }
159        }
160
161        return out;
162    }
163
164    private static String parseOrZero(String s) {
165        if (s == null) return "0";
166        String t = s.trim();
167        if (t.isEmpty()) return "0";
168        try {
169            Integer.parseInt(t);
170            return t;  // valid integer
171        } catch (Exception e) {
172            return "0";  // invalid → force 0
173        }
174    }
175
176    public void run() throws Exception {
177        System.out.println("Reading:  " + inputFile);
178        List<Map<String,String>> src = CsvIO.readSimpleCsv(inputFile);
179
180        System.out.println("Converting Squares...");
181        List<Map<String,String>> out = convert(src);
182
183        System.out.println("Writing:  " + outputFile);
184        CsvIO.writeSimpleCsv(outputFile, HEADER, out);
185
186        System.out.println("✔ Squares conversion complete.");
187    }
188
189    private static boolean isEffectivelyEmptyRow(Map<String,String> row) {
190        boolean hasRealValue = false;
191
192        for (String v : row.values()) {
193            if (v == null) continue;
194
195            String t = v.trim();
196
197            // Empty string → ignore
198            if (t.isEmpty()) continue;
199
200            // A "0" in Label Number or any numeric column is NOT meaningful → ignore
201            if (t.equals("0")) continue;
202
203            // Any other value means this row is a real data row
204            hasRealValue = true;
205            break;
206        }
207
208        return !hasRealValue;
209    }
210
211    /**
212     * For UNIQUE KEY:
213     *  "221012-Exp-1-A1-1-threshold-5 - 0" → "221012-Exp-1-A1-1-0"
214     *  "111111-Exp-11-A1-Threshold - 5 -1" → "111111-Exp-11-A1-1"
215     */
216    private static String stripThresholdForUniqueKey(String v) {
217        if (v == null) return "";
218        v = v.trim();
219        if (v.isEmpty()) return v;
220
221        java.util.regex.Matcher m = java.util.regex.Pattern.compile(
222                "^(.*?)-threshold\\s*-\\s*\\d+\\s*-\\s*(\\d{1,3})\\s*$",
223                java.util.regex.Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE
224        ).matcher(v);
225
226        if (m.matches()) {
227            String base = m.group(1).trim();  // before "-threshold..."
228            String last = m.group(2);         // final number
229            return base + "-" + last;
230        }
231        return v;
232    }
233
234    /**
235     * For RECORDING NAME:
236     *  "221012-Exp-1-A1-1-threshold-5"      → "221012-Exp-1-A1-1"
237     *  "111111-Exp-11-A1-Threshold - 5"    → "111111-Exp-11-A1"
238     */
239    private static String stripThresholdFromRecordingName(String v) {
240        if (v == null) return "";
241        v = v.trim();
242        if (v.isEmpty()) return v;
243
244        java.util.regex.Matcher m = java.util.regex.Pattern.compile(
245                "^(.*?)-threshold\\s*-\\s*\\d+\\s*$",
246                java.util.regex.Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE
247        ).matcher(v);
248
249        if (m.matches()) {
250            return m.group(1).trim();
251        }
252        return v;
253    }
254}
